result.topic_en: Euler discusses fifth-power residues modulo primes 2q+1: when q is not a multiple of 5 every number is a fifth-power residue, so prime divisors of a^4+a^3b+a^2b^2+ab^3+b^4 (other than a-b) have the form 10p+1; for primes 10p+1 there are only 2p distinct residues, and he begins deriving divisibility consequences from five numbers with equal fifth powers.
result.transcription:

VI. $B^2$, $B^2\alpha$, $B^2\beta$, $B^2\gamma$, etc. VIII. $B^4$, $B^4\alpha$, $B^4\beta$, $B^4\gamma$, etc.
Jam sive $AB$ dicatur esse residuum, sive non-residuum, absurdum sequitur; unde omnia non-residua, si quidem dantur, a quatuor prioribus classibus exhauriri necesse est.
470. Certum ergo est, quoties in divisore primo $2q+1$ numerus $q$ non fuerit multiplum quinarii, toties omnes numeros in residuis occurrere, eorumque multitudinem esse $=2q$. Neque ergo dantur duo numeri $a$ et $b$, minores quam $2q+1$, ut $a^5-b^5$ esset per $2q+1$ divisibile; hincque etiam $a^4+a^3b+aabb+ab^3+b^4$ per nullum numerum primum $2q+1$ dividi potest, in quo $q$ non sit multiplum quinarii.
471. Omnes ergo divisores primi numerorum hujus formae $a^4+a^3b+a^2b^2+ab^3+b^4$, seu hujus $a^5-b^5$, excluso divisore $a-b$, in hac formula $10p+1$ continentur, iique numeri nullo modo dividi poterunt per ullum numerum in aliqua harum formularum $10p+3$, $10p+7$ et $10p+9$ contentum.
472. At si divisor primus sit $10p+1$, non omnes numeri in ordine residuorum occurrent, si enim omnes occurrerent, foret $x^{2p}-1$ semper divisibile per $10p+1$, quicquid fuerit $x$, seu differentiae omnium harum potestatum $1$, $2^{2p}$, $3^{2p}$, $4^{2p}\ldots(2p+1)^{2p}$ per $10p+1$ essent divisibiles, cujus absurditas jam supra est ostensa.
473. Quare si divisor primus sit $10p+1$, numerus residuorum diversorum tantum est $=2p$, et $8p$ habebuntur non-residua, unde semper quini dabuntur numeri ipso $10p+1$ minores, $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, $e$, quorum potestates quintae paria producunt residua.
474. Scilicet proposito numero quocunque $a$, quatuor semper assignari possunt alii $b$, $c$, $d$, $e$, singuli divisore $10p+1$ minores, ut per eum divisibiles sint
hi numeri ac propterea isti quoque
$b^5-a^5$ $b^4+ab^3+a^2b^2+a^3b+a^4$
$c^5-a^5$ $c^4+ac^3+a^2c^2+a^3c+a^4$
$d^5-a^5$ $d^4+ad^3+a^2d^2+a^3d+a^4$
$e^5-a^5$ $e^4+ae^3+a^2e^2+a^3e+a^4$.
Haec eadem demonstratio ad praecedentes potestates accommodari potest.
475. Differentiae ergo etiam harum primae, a tribus sequentibus, per eundem divisorem dividi poterunt; hae autem differentiae, cum sint divisibiles per $b-c$, $b-d$, $b-e$, abeunt in has
$b^3+b^2c+bc^2+c^3+ab^2+abc+ac^2+a^2b+a^2c+a^3$,
$b^3+b^2d+bd^2+d^3+ab^2+abd+ad^2+a^2b+a^2d+a^3$,
$b^3+b^2e+be^2+e^3+ab^2+abe+ae^2+a^2b+a^2e+a^3$,
476. Porro vero harum differentias, sigillatim per $c-d$ et $c-e$ divisas, etiam per $10p+1$ divisibiles esse oportet, quae sunt:

methods.what: If prime 2q+1 has q not divisible by 5, every number is a fifth-power residue (2q residues)
methods.quote: quoties in divisore primo $2q+1$ numerus $q$ non fuerit multiplum quinarii, toties omnes numeros in residuis occurrere, eorumque multitudinem esse $=2q$

methods.what: Prime divisors of a^4+a^3b+a^2b^2+ab^3+b^4 (excluding a-b) are of form 10p+1
methods.quote: Omnes ergo divisores primi numerorum hujus formae $a^4+a^3b+a^2b^2+ab^3+b^4$, seu hujus $a^5-b^5$, excluso divisore $a-b$, in hac formula $10p+1$ continentur

methods.what: For prime 10p+1 there are exactly 2p distinct fifth-power residues and 8p non-residues; each residue arises from five numbers
methods.quote: numerus residuorum diversorum tantum est $=2p$, et $8p$ habebuntur non-residua, unde semper quini dabuntur numeri ipso $10p+1$ minores

methods.what: Proof by contradiction that not all numbers are fifth-power residues mod 10p+1, via x^{2p}-1
methods.quote: foret $x^{2p}-1$ semper divisibile per $10p+1$, quicquid fuerit $x$

methods.what: Successive differences of the quartic quotients divided by b-c etc. yield cubic expressions divisible by 10p+1

items.quote: Haec eadem demonstratio ad praecedentes potestates accommodari potest.
items.english: This same demonstration can be adapted to the preceding powers.
